questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.** 

According to the Copernican principle, the Earth does not (1)/ occupy a unique position in the Universe while (2)/ implies life on other planets can be a possibility. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Reading the above sentence we find that: 

 
• The word **while **is incorrectly used. 
 
• **While **is a noun that means a period of time. 
 
• It can also be used as a **conjunction** and as an **adverb **with the same meaning. 
 
• Instead, we should use a **pronoun **that is used to** refer to something previously mentioned. **
 
• **Which **is a pronoun that is used to refer to something previously mentioned. 
 
• Thus from the above points we can conclude that the error lies in part **2 **of the sentence. 

The correct sentence will be: *According to the Copernican principle, the Earth does not occupy a unique position in the Universe **which** implies life on other plants can be a possibility. *

Let's look at the meaning of the given options. 

 
• **Imminent**: About to happen.
 
• **Deponent**: Passive or middle in form but active in meaning.
 
• **Remnant**: A part or quantity that is left after the greater part has been used. 
 
• **Permanent**: Lasting or intended to last or remain unchanged indefinitely

Out of the given meanings, only the meaning of the word **permanent **is appropriate regarding the context of the sentence.

The correct sentence: *The love which is based on physical beauty is not **permanent**. *

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which will improve the bracketed part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select "no improvement". ** 

The bliss of (oversleeping) cuddled up under a warm and cosy blanket is just other-worldly.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **No improvement. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Reading the above sentence we find that:
 
• There is **no error **in the given sentence. 
 
• In the given question a general experience or activity is mentioned. 
 
• Therefore the correct noun for the activity is **oversleeping**. 
 
• Even though it ends with an **-ing**, oversleeping, in this case, is a noun or it is a gerund. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Gerund**: An -ing form of a verb that has the same function as a noun. 

 
 
• Example: **Sleeping **is good for health. 
 
 
 
• In the given example sleeping is an **-ing form of a verb** that is acting as a noun. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
